sql: SELECT co.name AS empresa, count(*) AS conversas_travadas, max(l.last_return_at) AS ultimo FROM wapi_conversations c JOIN campaign_leads l ON l.id = c.lead_id JOIN companies co ON co.id = l.company_id WHERE c.bot_step = 'lp_sent' AND l.status = 'perdido' AND l.last_return_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wapi_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.from_me = false AND m.timestamp > l.last_return_at) GROUP BY co.name ORDER BY 2 DESC
